label: letter l input late in the original phase (context-gated)
explanation: Fires almost only when the original-phase input is the letter l at position 4 or later (81% of activation mass on l inputs; peak rate at orig_idx 5-7). It never fires in the copy phase and only weakly on <DEL> (1.6% of mass). Positions 0-2 never fire. The other 19% of mass is weak activations on other letters at positions 5-7. It is a sparse, context-gated l detector: only about 8% of late l inputs activate it. Sequences that start with t (8x lift) or contain 1, e, k, f, p, h or y earlier activate it more often and more strongly. I could not find a simple prefix rule for that gating: the best (first token in {t,i,x,o,3,c,j,f} plus 2 or more of {f,1,p,e,k,h,y} seen) only reaches F1 0.32. Precision is therefore low (~0.08) while recall (0.72) and mass recall (0.81) are high.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=t (+5.30), orig2=1 (+4.29), orig1=f (+4.27), orig2=f (+4.04), prev_tok=e (+3.20), orig1=1 (+2.84). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-7.43), phase=2 (-4.50), orig0=b (-3.78), t=3 (-3.20).
